description: This Java source file defines a class whose purpose is to generate BSON objects for MongoDB queries based on field-existence expressions, specifically for use within a larger thing-search persistence framework. It implements visitor patterns to create appropriate BSON filters for different field types and paths.

classes.name: GetExistsBsonVisitor
classes.description: Implements methods to create BSON filters for field existence expressions, supporting attribute, feature, feature property, pointer, and root-level field criteria.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Creates a BSON object for the provided ExistsFieldExpression, optionally considering authorization subject IDs.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Generates a filter for the existence of a specific attribute field, escaping regex characters.

methods.name: visitFeature
methods.description: Generates a filter for the existence of a specific feature ID.

methods.name: visitFeatureIdProperty
methods.description: Generates a filter for the existence of a specific property within a feature.

methods.name: visitPointer
methods.description: Generates a filter based on a pointer string, matching internal fields or path key depending on context.

methods.name: visitRootLevelField
methods.description: Generates a filter to check existence of a root-level field.

methods.name: matchKey
methods.description: Creates a regex filter matching a specific key, considering authorization constraints.

methods.name: escapeAndWrapExistsRegex
methods.description: Escapes regex special characters and wraps the string appropriately for existence regex.

methods.name: escapeJavascriptRegex
methods.description: Escapes characters in a string that are special in JavaScript regex via prepending backslashes.
